chapters.heading: Single Storey Extensions Designed Around Your Home

blocks.html: Why go through the upheaval of moving when your current home already feels right? Instead, a well-planned extension can give you the additional space you need while keeping you in the area you love. You can expand your ground floor and create a home that better suits your lifestyle. From busy family life to relaxed entertaining, we can help you make better use of your existing space.

Whatever you have in mind, we’ll help you make every part of your extension work for you.
A Seamless Addition To Your Existing Layout

Your extension should feel like a natural part of your home, rather than an afterthought. So we consider your existing layout, property style and practical requirements when approaching your project. Helping connect your new space with the rooms you already use. Plus, matching materials, finishes and architectural details can also create a cohesive appearance. Resulting in a space that feels considered, comfortable and completely at home with your existing property.

chapters.heading: What Do Single Storey Extensions Cost?

blocks.html: Wondering how much your extension could cost? Every project has its own requirements. So prices can vary considerably. The size of your extension plays a major role, but other factors can affect your overall investment too. But don’t worry, we’ll help you understand the key considerations before construction begins. So you can make confident decisions about your design and budget.
Understanding The Main Project Costs
Several factors can influence the cost of a single storey extension. So understanding these early can help you plan your project with greater confidence.

blocks.html: Plus, your choice of materials and finishes can also affect the final specification. So we can discuss your priorities and help you create a project that delivers the space you need without unnecessary extras.
Choosing The Right Size And Specification

More space doesn’t automatically mean a better extension. Instead, the right design should give you useful room without creating unnecessary costs. Think about how you’ll use the space each day. Where will furniture sit? How will people move around? These details can make a surprisingly big difference to the finished result. And we’ll help you consider the practical side of your plans before work gets underway. That way, you can choose a size and specification that works for your home and budget.

chapters.heading: Single Storey Extensions Built For Everyday Living

blocks.html: A successful extension should make everyday life easier. Rather than simply increasing your floor area. Think about what frustrates you about your current layout. Could additional space solve those problems? Perhaps your kitchen feels cramped, your dining area lacks flexibility, or your living room needs more breathing space. Thankfully, a carefully planned extension can completely change how you use your home. Giving you greater freedom and flexibility.
Kitchens, Dining Spaces And Family Rooms

Kitchens often become the heart of the home, especially when you enjoy cooking and entertaining. And our single storey extensions can give you the room to create a more sociable kitchen and dining area. So you could introduce an island, a larger dining table or a comfortable seating area. Alternatively, you could create a dedicated family room alongside your kitchen. Combining different functions can give your ground floor greater flexibility throughout the day. So you’ll have somewhere to cook, eat, relax, work and entertain without everyone feeling crowded.
Making The Most Of Natural Light

Natural light can make a huge difference to how your new space feels. So large windows and glazed doors can bring more daylight into your extension. Creating a brighter and more welcoming environment. Or rooflights can add another source of natural light, particularly where wall space remains limited. And thoughtful positioning can also help connect your new room with your garden. Resulting in your space feeling brighter, more spacious and far more inviting.

Building an extension can feel like a major undertaking, particularly when you’re working around your existing home. You want the process to feel organised, clear and manageable from the beginning. So we take a practical approach to every project, focusing on good communication and quality workmanship throughout. Our aim remains simple: deliver an extension that works beautifully for your home and your lifestyle.
A Straightforward Building Process

We start by understanding what you want to achieve with your extension. Your priorities help shape the practical decisions throughout the project. Then, we can discuss your requirements, consider the existing property and establish what your build involves. From there, we can progress through the construction work with a clear focus on your finished space. Keeping the process organised helps minimise unnecessary disruption and keeps everyone focused on the job.
Quality Workmanship From Start To Finish

Your extension needs to stand up to everyday life. So every element requires careful attention. This includes everything from the structure through to the finishing touches. Fortunately, Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction takes pride in delivering quality workmanship across every stage. Approaching each project with care, precision and a strong focus on practical results. So you can expect an extension designed around your needs and built with lasting use in mind.
